questions.question: For the exact brand name 'Cipro', which brand RxCUI and term type does RxNorm return, which ingredient (IN) concepts are related to it, and is it a multi-ingredient product?
questions.answer_format: {brand_rxcui, brand_tty, ingredients:[{rxcui,name}] sorted by name, multi_ingredient}

questions.question: For NDC product 50419-754, what are the labeler, marketing category, application number and the description of package 50419-754-01? Does the listing's spl_set_id equal the S4 label set ID 888dc7f9-ad9c-4c00-8d50-8ddfd9bd27c0?
For the application number recorded in S2, what sponsor name does Drugs@FDA give, and which product numbers, dosage forms and strengths are listed?
questions.answer_format: {application_number, sponsor_name, products:[{product_number, dosage_form, route, active_ingredients}] sorted by product_number}

questions.question: In SPL set 888dc7f9-ad9c-4c00-8d50-8ddfd9bd27c0 version 32, section '5.14 Photosensitivity/Phototoxicity' (direct text only), classify 'sun or UV light exposure'.
questions.answer_format: One of reaction_or_warning, underlying_condition_or_risk_factor, symptom_of_other_condition, administration_instruction, contraindicated_population, exposure_factor, co_medication_risk_factor

questions.question: On the SrLC page for this application, which is the most recent entry with underlined (added/revised) text in Boxed Warning or sections 4, 5 or 6? Give its date, supplement and first such subsection, and the longest underlined passage in that subsection. Is that passage present in the S4 label version (letters and digits only, case-insensitive)?

For FAERS reports received 20250101–20251231: how many name the product 'CIPRO' exactly, and how many list its most frequent FAERS-coded active substance (any product)? For the brand-named reports, what are the 10 most frequent reaction terms with counts, and is each term found in the S4 label's in-scope sections (Boxed Warning, Contraindications, Warnings and Precautions, Warnings, Precautions, Adverse Reactions)?
questions.template_version: v2 (pilot T01 showed substance-level reports mix products)

questions.question: Among openFDA enforcement records for this ingredient (no application-level record exists), take the most recent by report_date. What are its recall number, classification, reason, reported status and report date? Does that record's own product_description or code_info name package 50419-754-01?
questions.answer_format: {query_level, records_found, recall_number, classification, reason_for_recall, status_as_reported, report_date, package_named_in_record, package_in_openfda_harmonized_list}

questions.question: From the captured search (interventional, completed, with results, largest enrollment first, 25 studies), take the first study with an adverse-event group whose title names the drug. Report the NCT ID, overall status, group ID and title, serious adverse events affected and at risk.
